common.tagline: A quiet place to be yourself.

landing.title: A quiet place to be yourself.
landing.body: Join circles that fit you, share in a safe space, and reach real people when you need someone to talk to.
privacyPoints: Use a nickname — your email is never shown.
We never ask you to state your orientation or identity.
No ad trackers. Delete your account and data any time.
landing.eyebrow: A private community for LGBTQ+ people
landing.footnote: Joining is by invitation or review.

features.title: Circles that fit you
features.body: Join open circles or request access to private ones. You only see what's relevant to you.

features.title: Real people to talk to
features.body: Ask a trusted responder privately. They never see who you are.

features.title: Privacy by design
features.body: Nicknames only, no ad trackers, no stored IPs. Delete everything any time.

signIn.title: Sign in or create an account
signIn.intro: We'll email you a one-time code. No password needed.
signIn.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
signIn.errorCode: That code is invalid or has expired.

onboarding.title: Join the community
onboarding.intro: Everyone here is either invited by a member or reviewed by our team. This keeps the space safe.
onboarding.handleHint: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, underscore. Avoid your real name.
onboarding.ageConfirm: I confirm that I am {age} or older.
onboarding.applyIntro: Answer a few questions. A moderator reads them, then they are deleted — only the decision is kept.

questions.why: Why would you like to join?
questions.lookingFor: What are you hoping to find or share here?
questions.guidelines: In your own words: how will you help keep this space safe and respectful?

onboarding.rejectedNote: Your previous application was not approved. You are welcome to apply again.

errors.invalid-invite: This invite code is invalid, used up or expired.
errors.invalid-answers: Please answer every question within the length limits.
errors.not-allowed: You can't do that right now.

onboarding.inviteOnlyNote: We're in a private beta — joining is by invitation only for now.

pending.title: Thanks — your application is in review
pending.body: A moderator will read it soon. If someone gives you an invite code meanwhile, you can use it right away.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: If you believe this is a mistake, contact the moderation team.
suspended.deleteHint: You can still delete your account and all your content in Settings.

home.title: Welcome, {name}

outcome.trust-too-low: Unlocks at a higher trust level

home.inviteBody: Only invite people you know and trust. If they break the rules, it reflects on you.
home.inviteLocked: You can invite others once you reach trust level 2.
home.feedEmpty: Join a circle to see posts here.

responder.title: Responder desk
responder.body: Paid questions assigned to you will appear here.

admin.title: Admin
admin.decisionNote: Answers are deleted as soon as you decide.

circle.requested: Your request is waiting for a moderator.
circle.privateNotice: This circle is private. Join to see its posts.
circle.mustJoin: Join this circle to post and comment.
circle.postLocked: You can start posts once you reach trust level 1. Commenting is open now.
circle.postsEmpty: No posts yet. Start the conversation!
circle.privacyReminder: Don't share anything that could identify you or others — no real names, workplaces or screenshots of chats.

post.reported: Thanks — a moderator will review it.
post.selfHarmNote: If someone may be in immediate danger, please also contact local emergency services or a crisis line.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.trust-too-low: This unlocks at a higher trust level.
errors.rate-limited: You've reached today's limit. Please try again later.
errors.invalid-input: Please check the length of what you wrote.
errors.own-content: You can't do that with your own content.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sessionsBody: Signed in on a device you no longer trust, or someone saw your phone? Sign out everywhere else.
settings.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account. Your posts and comments are erased and shown as “deleted by the author”. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteNeedsFresh: For your safety, please sign in again before deleting your account (sign-ins older than 15 minutes don't count).
settings.signInAgain: Sign out and sign in again

security.title: Two-factor authentication
security.intro: Staff accounts (admins and responders) must use an authenticator app. Until you verify, you only have regular member access.
security.notStaff: Two-factor authentication is currently required for staff accounts only.
security.setupSteps: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
security.backupBody: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe — they won't be shown again.
security.verifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
security.enabled: Two-factor authentication is on and this session is verified.
security.lostDevice: Lost your phone and your backup codes? Ask another admin to reset your 2FA.

errors.invalid-code: That code didn't work. Check your app's clock and try the newest code.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Please wait 15 minutes.
errors.not-enrolled: Two-factor authentication isn't set up yet.

goodbye.title: Your account has been deleted
goodbye.body: Your posts and comments have been erased. Thank you for being part of this community — take good care of yourself.

circlesPage.title: Circles
circlesPage.intro: Open circles are visible to every member. Private circles are only visible to the people inside.

help.title: You're not alone
help.intro: If you're in danger or thinking about hurting yourself, please reach out to a crisis line now. They're free and confidential, and they talk with people every day who feel the way you do.
help.emergency: In immediate danger? Call your local emergency number.
help.note: Responders on this site are peers sharing lived experience, not crisis counsellors.

qa.title: Talk to someone
qa.intro: Ask a responder privately. You're only charged if they answer within 48 hours — otherwise the hold on your card is released.
qa.anonymity: Responders never see your nickname or email.
qa.disclaimer: Responders are community members sharing lived experience — not therapists, doctors or lawyers. This isn't crisis care.
qa.empty: No responders are available right now. Please check back soon.
qa.bodyHint: Share as much as you're comfortable with. Leave out names, places or anything that could identify you.
how: Your card is only authorised, not charged.
The responder has 48 hours to answer.
You're charged only when the answer arrives.
qa.crisisBody: It sounds like you might be going through something really hard. You deserve support right now — a crisis line can talk with you today, for free.
qa.crisisAck: I'm safe right now and want to continue with my question
qa.waiting: Waiting for an answer. You'll only be charged once it arrives.
qa.checkoutDone: Payment authorised. Your question has been sent.
qa.checkoutPending: Confirming your payment… refresh in a moment.
qa.checkoutCancelled: Payment was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
qa.crisisBanner: Crisis language detected. Lead with care, share crisis resources, and don't give medical advice.
qa.answerHint: {min}–{max} characters. Sending it charges the asker.
qa.profileIntro: Set your headline, topics and price. You can accept questions once payouts are set up.
qa.headline: Headline
qa.payoutsNotReady: Set up payouts with Stripe to receive money.
qa.devCheckoutBody: Development only — no real card is used.

errors.invalid-input: Please check the length of what you wrote.
errors.unavailable: This responder isn't available right now.
errors.crisis-check: Please read the support information first.
errors.too-many-open: You already have 3 questions in progress.
errors.payment-failed: The payment couldn't be completed. Nobody was charged.

qa.refundedPartial: Partly refunded: {p} returned to your card.
qa.standingWarned: You've missed {n} deadline(s) in the last 30 days. At {m}, you'll be paused automatically.
qa.standingPausedOverdue: You're paused because of missed deadlines. Contact the team to resume.
qa.standingPausedAdmin: The team has paused your questions for now.
qa.applyIntro: Responders share lived experience with members who ask privately. The team reviews every application.
qa.applyExpHint: 30–1000 characters. No real names, places or anything identifying.
qa.applyGuidelines: I've read the responder guidelines: I'm a peer, not a therapist; I share crisis lines when someone may be at risk; I never ask for personal details; I answer within the time limit.
qa.applyPending: Your responder application is being reviewed.
qa.applyApproved: Your application was approved. Set up 2FA and payouts to start.
qa.applyNotEligible: You can apply from trust level 1.

applyErrors.invalid-input: Please write 30–1000 characters and accept the guidelines.
applyErrors.already-pending: You already have an application in review.
applyErrors.not-eligible: You can apply from trust level 1.

console.strip: Admin console · every action here is logged
console.alertCrisis: Crisis-flagged question #{id} has waited {n} h for @{r}
console.privacy: Titles, text and askers are hidden. You can open a question only for a review or a crisis safety check — each view is logged and lasts 30 minutes.
console.locked: Only disputed or crisis-flagged questions can be opened.
console.reasonTitle: Why do you need to read this?
console.question: Question

responders.title: Responders
responders.approveNote: Approving makes them a responder. They still need 2FA and payouts before they can take questions.

reviews.title: Review requests
reviews.refundHint: Up to {p}. A refund reverses the responder's share and the platform fee proportionally.

finance.title: Finance · last {n} days
finance.note: These totals mirror our own records. Stripe is the source of truth for balances, payouts and processing fees.

settings.title: Q&A settings
settings.warnAt: Warn after this many missed deadlines (30 days)
settings.pauseAt: Pause after this many missed deadlines (30 days)
settings.pauseHint: Responders are always warned before they can be paused.
settings.note: Changes apply to new questions only. Every change is logged.
settings.invalid: Please check the values. The pause threshold can't be lower than the warning threshold.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
